description: This shell script is part of the OpenWrt project and defines platform-specific functions for checking images, performing upgrades, and copying configurations based on different board names.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the image based on the board name, calling specific functions for certain board types.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on the board name, calling specific upgrade functions accordingly.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data depending on the board type.
